summary: Algoma Steel Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the timing for its 2026 second quarter earnings release and conference call. No special-situation event is present—the filing is a routine earnings reminder with no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change. The disclosure is purely operational and forward-looking statements regarding EAF transition are standard. As a foreign private issuer report on Form 6-K for a standard earnings schedule, it does not constitute a special situation filing.
